pages.title: The Unfolding Library
pages.summary: A paper crane folds itself through a library that rewrites its own shelves at night.
pages.body:
A quiet, papery metroidvania. You are [[wanderer|a paper crane]], newly folded from a discarded page, flying and climbing through a vast library whose shelves rearrange themselves every night. Nobody remembers who the librarian was.

## Tone
Hushed, warm lamplight and drifting dust, with an undertone of loneliness. Soft sound, rustling, the scratch of pens. Danger is gentle in look but real in consequence.

## Themes
- Memory and revision: what is kept, what is rewritten, what is lost.
- Becoming: a crane folded from a page must decide what it will say.
- Order versus change: the library's night-time rewriting is both threat and gift.

## The world
[[reading_room]] is where the crane wakes. Beyond it lie the [[shifting_stacks]], the flooded [[inkwell_cistern]], the clattering [[the_bindery]] and, at the top, [[the_night_desk]].

## Creatures
The library's own mechanisms guard it: [[crawler|Crawlers]] patrol the shelves and [[charger|Chargers]] burst from the aisles.

## Core loop
Explore by day, when the shelves are still. Return after the night rewrite to find old rooms changed, with new paths opened by each fold the crane learns: the Valley Fold (double jump), the Paper Wing (glide) and finally the Librarian's Seal.

pages.title: Wanderer
pages.summary: A paper crane folded from a lost page; the player character.
pages.body:
The Wanderer wakes on a reading table in [[reading_room]], still warm from the hands that folded it. It cannot speak; it moves, folds and flies.

The handwriting on its wing is a fragment of a sentence. Each region of the library reveals another fragment, and the ending reads them together at [[the_night_desk]].

Paper is light and fragile, so it moves in quick, buoyant arcs. It is hunted by [[crawler|Crawlers]] and [[charger|Chargers]], which treat it as a stray page to be reshelved.

fields.appearance: Small cream-white origami crane, creased wings, a faint line of half-erased handwriting on one wing
fields.motivation: To learn what was written on the page it was folded from, and who folded it

pages.title: Crawler
pages.summary: A bookworm-like shelf patroller made of binding thread and dust.
pages.body:
Crawlers are the library's upkeep, tidying and chewing loose paper. They are slow and predictable, and they teach the player to read platforms and timing.

After each night rewrite they reappear on different shelves, so their routes change. Used with [[charger|Chargers]], they pin the player into tight spaces.

fields.behavior: Creeps slowly along floors, walls and shelf edges, turning at ledges
fields.appearance: Segmented body of stitched binding thread and cloth spine, with two pin-bright eyes

pages.title: Charger
pages.summary: A heavy brass-cornered book-beast that rushes down the aisles.
pages.body:
Chargers are the library's guards, and the windup before a rush is the player's cue to dodge. Once stuck against a wall they are briefly stunned, which opens a window to slip past.

They are the heavier cousin of the [[crawler]]. Their fixed lines make them a test of the [[wanderer]]'s movement.

fields.behavior: Spots the player along a line, pauses to wind up, then charges in a straight line until it hits a wall
fields.appearance: Large tome with brass corners, ribbon-tail and a pair of page-flap jaws
fields.habitat: Long aisles of [[shifting_stacks]] and the floor of [[inkwell_cistern]]

pages.title: The Reading Room
pages.summary: A lamplit hall of tables where the crane is folded and wakes; the starting area.
pages.body:
The only place that never rewrites itself. The tables hold unfinished folding projects and half-written notes, which the [[wanderer]] reads as a tutorial in what it is.

It connects onward to the [[shifting_stacks]]. Later it is a hub to return to: its windows show how many nights have passed.

fields.appearance: Long oak tables, green-shaded lamps, tall windows showing a night sky, a spiral stair leading up

pages.title: The Shifting Stacks
pages.summary: Towering shelves that swap places each night, a changing maze of aisles and ledges.
pages.body:
The heart of the library's rewriting. Landmarks (a red-bound set, a cracked globe) stay fixed while the shelves around them move, so the player navigates by landmark and notices what has changed.

Its upper reaches lead to [[the_night_desk]], and its lowest aisles drain into the [[inkwell_cistern]].

fields.appearance: Shelves several storeys high, ladders hanging in mid-air, books that flutter like birds

pages.title: The Inkwell Cistern
pages.summary: A flooded undercroft where discarded words pool as black ink.
pages.body:
Everything the library erases drains here. Dried phrases, deleted chapters and names flake from the ceiling, and the ink holds the earliest fragment of the [[wanderer]]'s handwriting.

It lies beneath the [[shifting_stacks]]. Paper fears the ink, so the crane must cross it by wing and never touch it.

fields.appearance: Vaulted brick cellars, pools of glossy ink, drowned words drifting like fish

pages.title: The Night Desk
pages.summary: The librarian's empty desk at the top of the library, where the rewriting begins.
pages.body:
Every night the unseen pen writes a new arrangement of the shelves into the ledger, and the [[shifting_stacks]] obey. Here the [[wanderer]] reads its wing fragments against the ledger and chooses whether to let the rewriting continue, or to write its own line.

It is reached by climbing out of the [[shifting_stacks]], after crossing the [[inkwell_cistern]]. It is the intended ending.

fields.appearance: A single desk under a skylight, an open ledger, a pen still moving on its own

pages.title: The Bindery
pages.summary: A warm, clattering workshop of presses and glue pots between the cistern and the desk, where the library's pages are sewn.
pages.body:
The Bindery sits above the [[inkwell_cistern]] and below [[the_night_desk]]. Here pages are pressed, sewn and bound, and here the crane learns the pen's secret: every night's rewrite is stitched in by the presses.

Its keeper, the Warden of the Press, holds the [[librarians_seal]] that opens the way to the desk.

- Rooms: stitching hall, glue gallery, press floor, thread loft, the Warden's press.
- Reached from the cistern by a long glide across a vented chasm.

fields.mood: Warm, mechanical, urgent; clacking and the smell of glue
fields.appearance: Iron presses, spools of thread hung like chandeliers, drying racks of loose pages

pages.title: The Librarian's Seal
pages.summary: A wax seal pressed with an unreadable crest; the key to the Night Desk.
pages.body: Held by the Warden of the Press in [[the_bindery]]. Without it the stair to [[the_night_desk]] stays sealed.

fields.found: The Bindery, dropped by the Warden of the Press

pages.title: Waking
pages.summary: The crane is folded and wakes in the Reading Room.
pages.body: The crane unfolds on a lamplit table, reads a fragment of its own wing, and follows the spiral stair toward the [[shifting_stacks]].

pages.title: The First Fold
pages.summary: In the Stacks, the crane defeats a warden and learns to fold twice.
pages.body: A tome-warden guards the central aisles. Beaten, it yields the Valley Fold, a second lift in mid-air, opening the way down to the [[inkwell_cistern]].

pages.title: Drowned Words
pages.summary: In the Cistern, the crane finds discarded words and learns to glide.
pages.body: Among the drowned words the crane meets the Ink Warden, and wins the Paper Wing, letting it glide to the [[the_bindery]].

pages.title: The Seal
pages.summary: The Warden of the Press falls and the crane takes the seal and climbs to the desk.
pages.body: In [[the_bindery]] the crane learns the presses stitch each night's rewrite. It takes the [[librarians_seal]] and climbs to [[the_night_desk]], where it chooses what to write.

items.name: The Librarian's Seal
items.description: A wax seal pressed with an unreadable crest; the key to the Night Desk.

modals.title: You got Valley Fold
modals.body:
Jump again in mid-air.

It opens the way to The Inkwell Cistern.

modals.title: You got The Librarian's Seal
modals.body:
A wax seal pressed with an unreadable crest; the key to the Night Desk.

It opens the way to The Night Desk.

modals.title: You got Paper Wing
modals.body:
Hold jump while falling to fall slowly.

It opens the way to The Bindery and The Reading Room.

modals.title: The End
modals.body:
The librarian's empty desk at the top of the library, where the rewriting begins.

Thanks for playing Untitled Game.

modals.title: Untitled Game
modals.body: A paper crane folds itself through a library that rewrites its own shelves at night.

rooms.name: Waking Alcove
rooms.notes: Dusty reading nook where the player wakes. Quiet, safe, soft lamplight, a few low shelves. Teaches walking and jumping.

rooms.name: Long Reading Hall
rooms.notes: Wide hall of long tables and toppled chairs. First crawlers; room to learn combat.

rooms.name: Lamplit Landing
rooms.notes: Small landing with a green-shaded lamp and the region's save point. A breather.

rooms.name: Stack Gate Corridor
rooms.notes: Gallery of tall shelves leading toward the Stacks; shelves begin to lean. Also the lower end of the way back from the Bindery.

rooms.name: Leaning Aisle
rooms.notes: Shelves tilt and drift slowly. Narrow aisle between moving stacks.

rooms.name: Rearranging Maze
rooms.notes: Wide room of shelves that appear rearranged each visit; many platforms, crawlers lurking.

rooms.name: Ladder Shaft
rooms.notes: Tall shaft of stacked shelves, a climb up ledges of books.

rooms.name: Catalogue Nook
rooms.notes: Card-catalogue drawers form a cosy nook with a save point before the guardian.

rooms.name: Collapsed Row
rooms.notes: Fallen shelves make spiky paper-heaps and gaps.

rooms.name: Antechamber of Folds
rooms.notes: Origami-like paper folds adorn the walls; approach to the guardian.

rooms.name: The Folding Arena
rooms.notes: Open chamber where the charger guardian rushes across the floor. Defeating it grants Valley Fold (double jump).

rooms.name: Drain Mouth
rooms.notes: Entry from the Stacks: a dripping stone outflow, ink pooling at the floor edges.

rooms.name: Ink Walkways
rooms.notes: Long stone walkways over black ink pits; falling in hurts.

rooms.name: Sunken Well
rooms.notes: Deep well; descend ledge to ledge toward the cistern floor.

rooms.name: Quill Hub
rooms.notes: Central dry platform amid the ink, save point. A high ledge needs Valley Fold to reach the Paper Wing cache.

rooms.name: Blotted Passage
rooms.notes: Ink-stained crawl with spikes of dried quills.

rooms.name: Wide Ink Span
rooms.notes: A wide chasm of ink only crossable by gliding; exit toward the Bindery.

rooms.name: Glue Vestibule
rooms.notes: Entry to the workshop: smell of glue, thread spools and presses.

rooms.name: Press Floor
rooms.notes: Great iron presses slam on a long floor; crawlers among the machines.

rooms.name: Stitching Loft
rooms.notes: Loft of thread-strung rafters with a save point before the guardian.

rooms.name: Gilded Hall
rooms.notes: Hall of gilt spines. A glide-only ledge leads out to a one-way drop back to the Reading Room.

rooms.name: The Sealing Chamber
rooms.notes: Open chamber with a charger guardian holding the Librarian's Seal.

rooms.name: Sealed Threshold
rooms.notes: Door opened by the Seal; hushed marble, a single hanging lamp.

rooms.name: Quiet Stacks
rooms.notes: Silent last shelves, crawlers in the dark.

rooms.name: Last Lamp
rooms.notes: Save point before the ending.

rooms.name: The Night Desk
rooms.notes: The desk itself, the ending of the story.

rooms.name: Paper Wing Cache
rooms.notes: Hidden alcove above the Hub, guarded by a charger. Defeating it grants Paper Wing (glide).
